import type { CarouselContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Carousel extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        index: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        defaultIndex: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        layout: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        autoplay: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        intervalMs: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        playing: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultPlaying: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        loop: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        narrowIndicators: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        capacity: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    items: CarouselContract['items'];
    index: number | undefined;
    defaultIndex: number | undefined;
    layout: string;
    autoplay: boolean;
    intervalMs: number;
    playing: boolean | undefined;
    defaultPlaying: boolean | undefined;
    loop: boolean;
    private narrowIndicators;
    private capacity;
    private indexState;
    private playState;
    private stopped;
    private hovered;
    private explicitPlay;
    private reduced;
    private motionMedia?;
    private indicatorMedia?;
    private geometry?;
    private observedViewport;
    private timer?;
    private startX;
    private startY;
    private activePointer;
    private restoreVisibleFocus;
    private pendingStopFocus;
    constructor();
    get committedIndex(): number;
    get playingIntent(): boolean;
    get advancing(): boolean;
    private visible;
    private motion;
    private indicatorResize;
    private measure;
    private visibility;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    updated(): void;
    private navigate;
    private stop;
    private play;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
